Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
How long are school contracts?

Most follow the academic year, with some shorter contracts to cover leave. Summer programs come up too.

Do school roles need a special credential?

Often, yes. Many states require an education credential or certificate in addition to your clinical license. We tell you what the state and the district require.

What is different about correctional health?

The setting has extra security clearance and orientation steps. Your recruiter explains them, and the timeline, before you apply.
